title: Kashmiri Mustard-Oil Lamb Chop Feast
seoTitle: Kashmiri Mustard-Oil Lamb Chop Feast | Firehall BBQ
shortDescription: Tandoori lamb chops—not chicken—smoky yogurt char for the hall
subtitle: Yogurt-spiced lamb chops, char, and mint chutney for ten
description: Lamb loin chops marinate in tandoori yogurt spice, grill over high heat to 135°F, and serve on platters with mint-cilantro chutney and charred lemon.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Kashmiri Mustard-Oil Lamb Chop Feast in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on. Use fenugreek leaves, gram flour, pomegranate molasses as listed — measure each before heat goes on.

steps.title: Marinate lamb chops
steps.instruction: Coat chops in yogurt, tandoori masala, garam masala, garlic, ginger, and lemon juice. Marinate at least 4 hours refrigerated. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early. Target 165°F at the thickest point before moving to the next batch.

steps.title: Blend mint chutney
steps.instruction: Pulse mint, cilantro, green chilies, lemon juice, and pinch of salt until chunky. Chill until service. Keep finished cold items below 41°F if they sit more than 30 minutes — nest the hotel pan on ice at the line. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Heat grill hot
steps.instruction: Preheat grill to high, 475°F. Oil grates for yogurt-marinated lamb. Plan about 10 minutes for this step at crew scale. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early. Target 165°F at the thickest point before moving to the next batch.

steps.title: Grill chops first side
steps.instruction: Grill chops 4 minutes on first side over direct heat until charred and yogurt sets. Cook until char marks are visible and the thickest piece reads 165°F on an instant-read thermometer. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Flip and finish
steps.instruction: Flip and grill 3–4 minutes until 130–135°F internal for medium-rare. Move to cooler zone if flare-ups. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Char lemons
steps.instruction: Grill halved lemons cut-side down 2 minutes at 450°F for squeezing at service. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Rest and hold
steps.instruction: Rest chops 5 minutes to 140°F carryover. Hold covered at 170°F in hotel pans. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Platter for ten
steps.instruction: Two chops per firefighter with mint chutney and charred lemon. Call temps: pull at 135°F, hold at 170°F max. Plan about 5 minutes for this step at crew scale. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

proTips: Yogurt marinade chars like tandoor—don't wipe it off before grilling.
135°F pull with rest hits perfect pink for lamb loin.
Mint chutney cold on the side keeps bright during hold.
tonightSpread: Tandoori lamb chop platter with mint chutney.
leftovers: Pull meat from bones for lamb kathi rolls.
Chop into curry fried rice next shift.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Lamb chops feel like a reward meal and cook faster than shoulder. Tandoori yogurt marinade chars beautifully on direct grill heat and holds at 170°F between calls.
mealPrepNotes: Marinate chops 4–12 hours. Grill high 475°F, 4 minutes per side for medium-rare. Hold covered at 170°F up to 30 minutes. Chutney cold on the side.
